# discord_member (Data Source)

Looks up a server member by user ID or username. Usernames are the unique, lowercase Discord usernames (not display names). Requires the Server Members privileged intent for username lookups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_member" "alice" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  username  = "alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `user_id` (String) User ID. Exactly one of `user_id` or `username` is required.
- `username` (String) Unique username.

### Read-Only

- `bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `global_name` (String) Display name.
- `joined_at` (String) When the member joined the server.
- `nick` (String) Server nickname.
- `roles` (Set of String) IDs of the member's roles.
